# dokku_network (Data Source)

Creates or destroys a Docker network

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_network" "example" {
  name = "example-network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the network

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
